item.title: LeBron James on Hillary Clinton
item.description:
LeBron James' message to Hillary Clinton supporters Sunday in Cleveland could be one of encouragement for African-Americans to vote.

“A lot of times black people don't vote because they don't feel like their votes count,”

LeBron James on Hillary Clinton, Nov 5, 2016. Source: Cleveland Plain Dealer.

item.title: LeBron James on Hillary Clinton
item.description:
James told cleveland.com.

“You talk to a black person and they say 'I'm not voting because I don't think my vote matters.'That's my message, that voting does matter. We just want to feel like our votes matter.”

LeBron James on Hillary Clinton, Nov 5, 2016. Source: Cleveland Plain Dealer.
